zh.principle: **协议**：SRTP 安全实时传输（Secure Real-time Transport Protocol）。RFC 3711 摘要给出定位与能力清单：「This document describes the Secure Real-time Transport Protocol (SRTP), a profile of the Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP), which can provide confidentiality, message authentication, and replay protection to the RTP traffic and to the control traffic for RTP, the Real-time Transport Control Protocol (RTCP).」即它是 RTP 的密码学剖面，同时管媒体与控制流量。
zh.why: 摘要说明它给 RTP 与 RTCP 控制流量补上安全服务：「a profile of the Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP), which can provide confidentiality, message authentication, and replay protection to the RTP traffic and to the control traffic for RTP, the Real-time Transport Control Protocol (RTCP).」注意措辞是 can provide——能力取决于所选密码套件与密钥管理，不是默认全开。
zh.used: 使用面是音视频与实时会话的承载加密：文档以「a profile of the Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP)」界定其作用位置，并在框架一节定义密码上下文与包处理流程；语音、视频会议等实现按该剖面套用在既有 RTP 报文之上。
zh.broken: 限度一是它不规定密钥管理协议：§1 明确安全性有条件——「With appropriate key management (Sections 7 and 8), SRTP is secure (Sections 9) for unicast and multicast RTP applications (Section 11).」§8 名为 Key Management Considerations，对所使用的密钥管理提出约束，却不定义协商协议。限度二是保护范围只到 RTP/RTCP 流量，与应用层协议无关。

en.principle: **Protocol**: Secure Real-time Transport Protocol (SRTP 安全实时传输). The abstract supplies both placement and capability list: "This document describes the Secure Real-time Transport Protocol (SRTP), a profile of the Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP), which can provide confidentiality, message authentication, and replay protection to the RTP traffic and to the control traffic for RTP, the Real-time Transport Control Protocol (RTCP)." It is a cryptographic profile of RTP, covering media and control traffic.
en.why: The abstract states the services it adds to RTP and its control protocol: "a profile of the Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP), which can provide confidentiality, message authentication, and replay protection to the RTP traffic and to the control traffic for RTP, the Real-time Transport Control Protocol (RTCP)." The wording is can provide — the services depend on the selected cipher suite and on key management rather than being unconditional.
en.used:
In practice it secures audio, video and interactive sessions: the document places itself as "a profile of the Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP)" and its framework section defines cryptographic contexts and packet processing, applied on top of existing RTP payloads by voice and video-conferencing implementations.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken: The first limit: no key-management protocol is specified. §1 makes security conditional — "With appropriate key management (Sections 7 and 8), SRTP is secure (Sections 9) for unicast and multicast RTP applications (Section 11)." — and §8, Key Management Considerations, constrains whatever key management is used without defining an agreement protocol. The second limit is scope: protection covers RTP and RTCP traffic, not the application protocols carried inside them.
en.history: The masthead and copyright block carry the history: Request for Comments 3711 from the Network Working Group, dated March 2004, under "Copyright (C) The Internet Society (2004). All Rights Reserved." — the IETF Trust copyright wording belongs to later documents. The file defines SRTP as a profile of RTP rather than a new transport protocol.

zh: RTP：实时传输协议，承载媒体流。
profile：在既有协议上叠加规则的剖面。
message authentication：消息认证，来源与完整性。
replay protection：重放防护，依赖包序与窗口。
en: RTP: the Real-time Transport Protocol carrying media.
Profile: rules layered onto an existing protocol.
Message authentication: origin and integrity of a message.
Replay protection: rejecting re-injected packets via ordering and windows.
